title: Two Player Required
description: A co-op-only datapack: play alone and you're stuck in Adventure mode with blindness and a "waiting for other players" message until a second player joins, then you're switched back to Survival. Survival only.
body:
Two Player Required

A small datapack that turns your world into a co-op-only experience. You simply can't play on your own anymore.

How it works

If you're the only one online, the world basically puts itself on hold. You'll get hit with permanent blindness, you're dropped into Adventure mode so you can't break or place anything, and a red "WAITING FOR OTHER PLAYERS" message sits on your screen.

The moment a second player logs in, it all sorts itself out on its own. The blindness clears, you're put back into Survival, and the message disappears. From there you just play normally.

The whole point is that nobody gets to start until everyone's actually there.

SURVIVAL ONLY

Just so it's clear: THIS ONLY WORKS IN SURVIVAL. It's not built for Creative or Adventure worlds, so don't expect it to behave there.

Made for Minecraft Java 1.21+.
